messages:
sara: kicking off a split-region progressive rollout for inference runtime v2.4.0 -> starting with 5% traffic to eu-west, 0% in us-east. watching latency, error rate, and tool-call integrity. cc @miguel @amelia :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout rl-98123 initiated · target=service/inference · variant=v2.4.0 · weights={eu-west:5, us-east:0} · status=canary · started_by=sara

miguel: seeing 95p latency bump on short-context requests in eu-west: baseline ~120ms -> ~220ms in the last 3m. small sample attached. investigating KV cache warmup contributions.

amelia: spotted ~0.6% tool-call malformations in the same timeframe, payloads with unexpected prompt tokens. snippet:
```
ERROR caller=toolchain handler=tool-invoke id=0x7f payload="{\"tool\":\"embedder\",\"args\":...}" reason=BadArgs
```
Not huge but correlated with the latency spike.

tj: suggest we HOLD at 5% until KV cache warms and we confirm error trend settles. also recommend pinning us-east to v2.3.1 for safety if we see >1% malformed calls.

dave: runbook excerpt: "Abort and rollback if request_error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR 95p_latency > 400ms for 5m." We're below both for now, but trending.

deploy-bot: health-checks: error_rate=0.72% · 95p_latency=215ms · qps=42 · anomaly_score=0.31

sara: thanks. proposal: pause weight ramp, hold at 5% for 15m, run focused traces + promptset evals, then decide. If malformed_calls > 1% or 95p > 300ms, rollback to 0% in eu-west and pin region to v2.3.1. sound good?

amelia: +1 to hold and run promptset. I'll start a small eval run against the canary traffic logs and post results in 10m.

miguel: I'll attach KV cache heatmap and cold-start traces in ~8m.

ops-bot: monitoring-rule "canary-latency-watch" armed by sara · threshold=95p>300ms · window=5m

deploy-bot: rollout paused by operator request (sara) · rl-98123 · current_weights={eu-west:5, us-east:0} · status=HOLD

sara: decision: HOLD and pin us-east routes to v2.3.1 for the duration of this canary test. no further ramp until we have confirmation from @amelia and @miguel. i'll mark change window to extend by 30m.

amelia: quick eval: on the in-flight promptset, regeneration quality looks stable but malformed calls are concentrated on requests that hit the new tokenizer path. sending example IDs in thread.

miguel: KV warmup shows gradual drop in latency over next 12m in synthetic tests — appears consistent with cache density.

dave: acknowledging pin intent. will prepare rollback job in case threshold breached.

sara: if after 30m malformations >1% or 95p>300ms -> rollback to 0% and create a follow-up postmortem. otherwise we'll resume ramp to 20% across eu-west.

ops-bot: no automated rollback triggered so far. next check at +10m.

deploy-bot: note: manual pin applied to us-east -> variant=v2.3.1 · reason=canary_hold_by_sara

tj: thanks everyone. small ask: let's add an A/B eval tag to the rollout so Redwood Optimize can compare quality delta automatically. low lift.

sara: done — added tag=ab_eval=canary-kv-warmup. we'll reconvene at +15m here with results. :clock15:

amelia: posting eval summary in 12m, will call for rollback if >1% malformations.

miguel: will post heatmap shortly.

[thread ends]
